negatives.observed_failure: The first read-only package query passed an array to a parameter that accepts one package name.
negatives.recovery: Queried the two installed package names separately and recorded both versions without updating either application.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the failed query is retained and uncounted

negatives.observed_failure: The first console report encountered a Windows CP1252 encoding error on Māori text after sixteen records.
negatives.recovery: Reran with UTF-8 output encoding and decoded all 190 frozen records.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; only the complete UTF-8 rerun supports novelty review

negatives.observed_failure: A PowerShell environment assignment was placed inside a pipeline and produced a parser error.
negatives.recovery: Set UTF-8 output before the pipeline and completed the read-only inspection.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; retained as an operational negative

negatives.observed_failure: The first collector assumed every historical index used new_records and stopped at the older records schema.
negatives.recovery: Added read-only support for both new_records and records schemas and loaded 190 unique proposals.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the incomplete collector is not evidence

negatives.observed_failure: A combined optional-path query returned nonzero when the second, unnecessary junction name did not exist.
negatives.recovery: Used the already existing Tamar-owned junction that resolved to the verified worktree.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no worktree or branch was created or changed

negatives.observed_failure: The first help query used a plausible but nonexistent scanner filename.
negatives.recovery: Located and verified the family-current ghc_family_phase_privacy_scan.py interface.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the failed filename is retained and no scan was inferred

negatives.observed_failure: The run completed 397 tests with two failures in inherited frozen-index hash portability checks.
negatives.recovery: Traced both failures to LF versus CRLF materialization of immutable text, kept the run uncounted, and added bounded line-ending-only compatibility plus mutation regressions.
negatives.promotion_effect: the 395-of-397 run is not passing evidence; only a complete rerun may satisfy the x1 gate

negatives.observed_failure: A ripgrep path argument used a Windows-invalid wildcard form after the relevant validator excerpt had already printed.
negatives.recovery: Located the validator from the importing test module and inspected it by its exact repository-relative filename.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; retained as an operational negative

negatives.observed_failure: A compound read-only inspection returned nonzero because its final optional text search had no match.
negatives.recovery: Used the displayed test import lines and exact validator filename; no result was inferred from the empty search.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; retained as an operational negative

negatives.observed_failure: A proposed shared-validator repair fixed the original pair but changed a file sealed into the inherited v643-v4 manifest, so the run completed 399 tests with three manifest failures.
negatives.recovery: Abandoned and fully reverted the shared-file change, preserved the historical manifest, and moved the recovery to a phase-scoped semantic-preserving checkout materializer.
negatives.promotion_effect: the 396-of-399 run is not passing evidence and the rejected shared repair is not part of x1

negatives.observed_failure: A combined diff and status command reached its ten-second timeout while Git inspected the large checkout.
negatives.recovery: Reran bounded status and end-of-line checks with adequate time, normalized only working-copy line endings, and confirmed no shared semantic diff remained.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the timed-out check is retained and uncounted

negatives.observed_failure: The first bounded patch used stale exact context after nearby text had changed and was rejected without modifying the file.
negatives.recovery: Inspected the exact current lines and applied the narrower phase-scoped portability patch successfully.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the rejected patch is retained and made no repository change

negatives.observed_failure: A cleanup patch targeted a superseded receipt name that had never been generated, so the patch was rejected without change.
negatives.recovery: Verified the path was absent and allowed the current builder to generate only the phase-scoped materialization plan.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no file was deleted or modified

negatives.observed_failure: An overbroad diagnostic pattern matched the boundary phrase private callable rather than a callable identifier, and a compound PowerShell command did not propagate that intermediate nonzero exit.
negatives.recovery: Refined the scan to identifier-shaped tokens, reran it with explicit exit propagation, and kept the original attempt uncounted.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no private identifier was found and the false-positive attempt is retained

boundary: Recovered failures remain negatives and are not counted as successful evidence runs.
